related_questions.question: How to check if COVID is gone?
related_questions.snippet: You'll know you're getting better once your symptoms lessen or disappear altogether. Signs that COVID is getting better vary from person to person and depend on your symptoms. For example, if you had a fever for several days but are now fever free without taking a fever-reducing medicine, that's a sign of recovery.

related_questions.snippet: Takeaways. If you have been exposed to someone with COVID-19, you may begin to show symptoms after a 3-5 day incubation period. The amount of time will depend on the variant you were exposed to. Staying up to date on COVID-19 booster vaccinations will lower your chances of becoming seriously ill with the virus.

related_questions.question: How fast can you find out if you have COVID?
related_questions.snippet: NAATs tests are the “gold standard” for COVID-19 tests. Your sample will usually be taken by a healthcare provider and transported to a laboratory for testing and may take up to 3 days to receive results. Some NAATs may be performed at the point-of-care and provide results more quickly.
